title: Security Boundaries — Auth, HTTPS, Sanitisation, Access Control
description: Defense-in-depth security controls across the application stack

nodes.label: Content Security Policy
nodes.description: script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' tiles.openfreemap.org server.arcgisonline.com

nodes.label: Better Auth (Primary)
nodes.description: Email/password, bcrypt, 7-day sessions, admin plugin, CSRF protection

nodes.label: Firebase Auth (Legacy)
nodes.description: Landlord portal only — being phased out

nodes.label: Firestore Rules
nodes.description: Landlord profile read/write restricted to owner UID

nodes.label: Vite Env Variables
nodes.description: VITE_* exposed to client; secrets only in server (BETTER_AUTH_SECRET)

nodes.label: Error Sanitisation
nodes.description: error-capture.ts scrubs request body, headers, URLs before logging

nodes.label: Zero Tracking
nodes.description: No cookies, no analytics, no pixels, no fingerprinting

nodes.label: Self-Hosted Assets
nodes.description: Fonts, icons, videos — no third-party CDNs for code

nodes.label: GitHub + Vercel 2FA
nodes.description: Branch protection, only founder has deploy access

nodes.label: Data Minimisation by Design
nodes.description: No DB for listings (static file), no auth for students, no forms
